Rule. Hold this rule for Replication and consistency: Say what a replica is for, and what a client observes after a write. Say it before you pick a tool from System design.

Why it matters. Interviewers on the System design track listen for whether you can name the idea replication and consistency and refuse the common wrong pick. The summary is the force: Say what a replica is for, and what a client observes after a write. If you cannot restate it, you will drift into product names or trivia.

When to use. Use Replication and consistency when the prompt's access pattern or force matches the summary above, when a prior slug in its after-list is already in hand, and when saying the rule changes which next step you take.
